channel.title: EngineerzCorneR — Posts
channel.description: Deep-dive technical write-ups across Electrical, Mechanical, HVAC, Automation, Civil and Solar.

item.title: Motor Starting Methods: DOL vs Star-Delta vs Soft Starter vs VFD Compared
item.description: Why starting current matters, how DOL, star-delta, soft starters and VFDs each tame it differently, and a comparison of current, torque, cost and complexity.

item.title: VFD Internal Architecture: Rectifier, DC Bus & Inverter Explained
item.description: Inside a variable frequency drive: how the rectifier, DC bus and IGBT inverter stages turn fixed AC into a variable-frequency PWM output, and why that switching creates the harmonics and reflected-wave issues drives are known for.

item.title: VFD Speed Scaling: Why Affinity Laws Make Small Speed Cuts Deliver Outsized Savings
item.description: Motor speed scaling with VFD output frequency, and why the pump/fan affinity laws mean modest speed cuts trim power consumption by a much larger percentage.

item.title: ANSI Relay Numbers: Common Protection Relay Functions
item.description: A working reference for the ANSI device numbers you'll actually run into on protection schemes — 50/51, 27/59, 87, 21, 67, 25 and more.

item.title: How to Read a Full P&ID: A Complete Worked Walkthrough
item.description: A start-to-finish walkthrough of reading a P&ID — symbols, tag anatomy, valve types, and a fully worked example tracing one real control loop end to end.

item.title: Single Line Diagram (SLD) Symbols & How to Read One
item.description: The standard symbols used on a power single line diagram — generator, transformer, breaker, disconnect, CT/VT, busbar, relay — and the order engineers actually read one in.

item.title: IEC 104 Communication Protocol Explained
item.description: What IEC 60870-5-104 does, how it extends IEC 101 over TCP/IP, the master-slave request/response model, a security reference, and where it's used in SCADA.

item.title: IEC 61850 Digital Substation Protocol Explained
item.description: How IEC 61850 replaces hardwired substation panels with GOOSE, Sampled Values and MMS over Ethernet — the process/bay/station architecture, what each service actually carries, and the security tradeoffs.

item.title: Chiller Capacity and COP: Where the Compressor's Work Actually Goes
item.description: Refrigeration cycle capacity, COP and compressor power, and why condenser heat rejection has to account for the compressor's work input.

item.title: Data Center Cooling: Air to Immersion
item.description: What data center cooling actually has to solve, the main types — CRAC, CRAH, in-row, rear-door heat exchanger, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, single- and two-phase immersion, free cooling — parts of a liquid cooling loop, a rack-density selection guide, and PUE explained.

item.title: Heat Pump Sizing Basics: Why Electrification Made This a Core Skill
item.description: Why heat pump sizing isn't the same exercise as furnace or AC sizing, what COP and capacity-at-temperature actually mean.

item.title: Refrigerant Types: R-410A to A2L
item.description: Why HVAC is transitioning away from R-410A, the ASHRAE 34 safety classification (A1/A2L/B2L), R-32 vs R-454B vs R-1234yf vs natural refrigerants compared by GWP and flammability, what changes for A2L handling, and a selection reference.

item.title: Arc Flash Hazard Basics

item.title: Breaker Selectivity: Why Two Correctly Rated Breakers Can Still Trip Together

item.title: Electrical Panel Factory Acceptance Test (FAT): The Complete Checklist

item.title: Permit to Work & LOTO: Why the Lock Belongs to the Person, Not the Job
item.description: What a permit to work actually authorizes, why lockout/tagout requires one lock per person rather than one lock per job.

item.title: Prospective Short-Circuit Current: Why It Falls the Further You Are From Source
item.description: How prospective short-circuit current is calculated per IEC 60909, why it's highest at the transformer and drops downstream.

item.title: Power Semiconductors: Si, SiC & GaN
item.description: Silicon IGBT/MOSFET, silicon carbide (SiC), and gallium nitride (GaN) power semiconductors compared — bandgap, switching frequency, voltage range, and losses — where each one fits, a selection guide by application, and the key terms explained.

item.title: String vs Microinverter vs Power Optimizer: Choosing a Solar Inverter Topology
item.description: How string inverters, microinverters and power optimizers differ in where MPPT happens, what a shaded panel costs under each, and how to pick between them.

item.title: What Is an Inverter? DC-to-AC Conversion Explained

item.title: Battery SoC vs DoD: Why They're Not the Same Number

item.title: BESS Types & Components Explained

item.title: UPS Architecture, Types & Operating Modes Explained
item.description: How an online double-conversion UPS is built — rectifier/charger, battery bank, inverter, static switch and bypass — plus the three operating modes.

item.title: UPS Battery Sizing: Why the Nameplate Ah Never Matches What You Actually Get

item.title: Pump Types Explained: Centrifugal to PD

item.title: Industrial Sensor Types Explained

item.title: Cooling Tower Types Explained
item.description: What a cooling tower actually does, the main types — counterflow, crossflow, natural draft, forced draft, induced draft, open circuit, closed circuit, hybrid — its parts, a selection guide, and common failure points.

item.title: Circuit Breaker Types Explained: MCB to OCB
item.description: What a circuit breaker actually does, the main types — MCB, MCCB, ACB, VCB, OCB, SF6, air-blast, GIS — its parts, an interrupting-medium reference, a voltage-class selection guide, and common failure points.

item.title: Main Components of a 33 kV Substation Explained
item.description: Every stage of a 33 kV substation feeding a 0.433 kV LT network — HT switchgear, transformer feeder, power transformer, LT panel and outgoing distribution.

item.description: Cable tray, ladder, trunking, and conduit compared — construction, protection level, typical load, where each is used, and how to choose.
